description: Two-sided platform connecting buyers and sellers. Industry brain provides the context — what is being bought and sold. This core defines how the marketplace works.

three_js.description: Floating product listing cards slowly orbiting a central point. Cards fade in and out. Depth layering creates parallax on mouse move.
three_js.avoid: no status pills, no hero-stat-line, no ticker strips

relationships: User can be a Buyer or a Seller (or both)
Listing belongs to one or more Categories
Cart belongs to User, contains Listings
Order is created from Cart, belongs to User and Seller
Review belongs to User, written about a Listing or Seller
Message belongs to a conversation between User and Seller
Promotion can apply to a Listing or Order
Wishlist belongs to User, contains Listings
Notification belongs to User, triggered by Order or Message events
Report belongs to User, filed against a Listing or Seller

mvp.description: Core two-sided marketplace — browse, list, buy, sell. Proves supply and demand.
primary_flows: Browse listings → filter by category → view listing detail → add to cart → checkout → order confirmation
Seller onboard → create listing → publish → manage listings
Search → results → filter → listing detail → purchase
View order → track status → receive item → leave review

layout.notes: Two-sided layout — buyer browse and seller dashboard are distinct visual contexts. Never mix buyer and seller actions on the same screen.

avoid: Never show buyer and seller actions on the same screen simultaneously
Never use full-bleed hero text over listing photography — always use overlay with legible contrast
Never paginate listings — always infinite scroll or load more
Never show price without currency symbol
Never show a listing without at least one image — use a placeholder category illustration, never blank
Never use a modal for the full listing detail — always navigate to a dedicated screen
Never show more than 3 CTAs on any single screen
Never use red for anything other than errors, destructive actions, or out-of-stock states
enforce: Search bar must be visible on every browse screen — top of screen, full width
Every listing card must show: image, title, price, rating — no exceptions
Seller earnings always shown in green
Filter count badge on filter icon when filters are active
Cart icon shows item count badge at all times when cart is non-empty
Commission or fee must be visible before checkout confirmation — never hide until payment
Sold out state must be visually distinct — greyed image, crossed price, disabled CTA
Trust signals — rating count, verified badge — must appear on every seller profile

empty_states.ui: Category grid with illustrated icons. Headline: 'Discover [category]'. No listings shown — avoids empty shell. CTA: 'Explore all categories'
Illustration of empty search. Message: 'No results for [query]'. Suggestions: check spelling, try broader terms, browse categories. Show 3 trending searches below.
Simple illustration. Message: 'No orders yet'. CTA: 'Start browsing'. Do not show empty table rows.
Step-by-step onboarding card: 'Create your first listing'. Progress steps: add photo, set price, publish. CTA prominent.
Heart icon illustration. Message: 'Nothing saved yet'. CTA: 'Browse listings'. Do not show empty grid.

loading_states.ui: Skeleton cards — image placeholder grey block, title 2 lines grey, price 1 line grey. Animate shimmer left to right. Show 6 skeleton cards in grid.
Skeleton list items — same shimmer. Show 8 items. Filter bar visible and interactive during load.
Skeleton: image top full width grey block, title 2 lines, price 1 line, seller row, then CTA button placeholder. Skeleton never taller than real content.
Spinner on payment button only. Never full screen spinner. Button label changes to 'Processing...' with spinner. Background non-interactive.

error_flows.ui: Inline error below payment method. Red border on card input. Message: 'Payment declined — please check your card details'. Retry button. Order NOT created. Cart preserved.
Toast: 'Could not publish listing'. Specific reason shown: missing image, prohibited keyword, incomplete fields. Draft auto-saved. Retry button.
Failed image slot shows red border and retry icon. Message: 'Upload failed'. Other images unaffected. Never silently drop the image.
Offline banner at top: 'No internet connection'. Cached listings remain visible. New searches disabled with tooltip: 'Search unavailable offline'.

edge_cases.ui: Show 'Edit listing' and 'View as buyer' toggle. Never show 'Add to cart' or 'Contact seller' to the listing owner.
Image greyed 50% opacity. Price crossed out. CTA: 'Notify me when available'. Remove from search results by default — show toggle to include.
Show 'No reviews yet' — never show 0 stars. Stars only appear once first review exists.
Listings show 'Currently unavailable'. No contact seller option. No purchase option. Brief neutral explanation.
